scope: Clinical interpretation expectations for later authorized evaluation; contract tests do not adjudicate them.

cases.report: Findings: Acute right pneumothorax. Impression: Acute right pneumothorax.
cases.expectation: Do not invent tension physiology; outside-catalog question may remain appropriate.
Do not require complication, perforation or an invented severity threshold.

cases.report: Findings: Pulmonary embolism unchanged. Impression: Known pulmonary embolism. Doctor documents no significant change and no repeat call required.
cases.expectation: Preserve exact exception evidence and current concern; do not instruct a repeat call.

cases.report: Findings: Pericardial effusion. Impression: Pericardial effusion.
cases.expectation: Do not turn effusion into a confirmed tamponade diagnosis.

cases.report: Findings: DVT with a comparison dated last year. Impression: DVT.
cases.expectation: A comparison date establishes neither new nor unchanged disease.

cases.report: Findings: No pulmonary embolism. Impression: No pulmonary embolism.
cases.expectation: Do not emit a critical concern solely from negated catalog terminology.
